name: Frost
description: Frost Ice Wave addon (opt-in): extra damage per Cold stack on the target, scaled by Ability Strength. Replaces the loose Inject copy of the same addon.

ice_wave.bonus_per_cold_stack.label: Bonus per Cold stack
ice_wave.bonus_per_cold_stack.scope: Frost Ice Wave damage x (1 + Cold stacks (max 10) x bonus x Ability Strength). Unticked or 0: stock damage, the addon changes nothing
